findings.title: Station information and station list
findings.behavior: Station right click and the property dialog Information button open live counters: name; loaded, unloaded and train calls today/yesterday; waiting passengers versus demand (population). Manifest dockingContent registers StationList through DockingContribution; its sorted list subscribes to world/station changes and double-click moves map views. Replace name/hashcode/index correlation with stable station IDs; preserve keyboard/touch access.

findings.title: Train information and continuous tracking differ
findings.behavior: TrainInformationWindow has nested group/train selection, name/state, car count, total capacity, passenger count/percentage and Move. MapView creates a separate TrainTrackingWindow with a tracking checkbox. System dockingContent registers TrainInformationWindow; this is a proven separate entry route. Existing web find-train/inspector is partial, not continuous tracking.

findings.title: Speed-limit construction and cleanup
findings.behavior: Registered menu initializes SpeedLimit and supplies level section, slope section and remove-not-on-traffic cleanup. Level tool has add/remove, two map endpoints and low/medium/high choices; slope tool adds four direction picks and its own interaction. These are railway tools, not alternative global clock speeds. Resolve exact speed values, slope placement/deletion and train movement in P0-04/06; do not infer units from translated labels.

findings.title: Second terrain tool
findings.behavior: Mountain2 rectangular raise/excavate uses RectSelectorController; Ctrl switches to checking and repairing mismatched adjacent corners. Keep the registered second tool distinct from MountainController corner editing and terrain image import; provide an explicit accessible repair action rather than requiring a global modifier.

findings.title: Report periods and history windows
findings.behavior: AccountSummaryWindow has six periods: today/yesterday, this/last month, this/last year. Context actions open daily and monthly histories; each offers sales/expenditure/balance, genre selection and fonts. Preserve 31-day/12-month columns and rollover semantics as P0-05/06 obligations. Close menu text without an event remains a source gap, not verified behavior.

findings.title: Timetable copy and station-rule files
findings.behavior: Controller manager adds copy with BinaryFormatter cloning and a unique derived name. Station advanced rules add copy, clear-all confirmation, read/append and save of .ftdd rule collections, duplicate time-mask checking on Add, and forwarding/reverse variants. Copy/import bypassing Add and sorted UI versus rule execution order require explicit P0-06 cases. Adapt source file dialogs to validated service commands/drafts; do not run BinaryFormatter in the browser/service. Historical day-from-month edit defect remains visible.

findings.title: Platform choices, cost and consumed passage materials
findings.behavior: Platform controller replaces slim checkbox with wide, slim roofed and slim unroofed radios; station/platform previews and charges are explicit. Footbridge type selects concrete, brown wood or green wood and is consumed by passage/stair outlooks and floating previews. Historical ACTION-009 unused-selector claim is superseded for ExAV. Empty-voxel branches remain separately incomplete; material support does not close all footbridge construction.

findings.title: Options include game rules and local presentation
findings.behavior: ConfigDialog adds train labels, electric-pole visibility, station/train font and color dialogs (8–16 designer limits), bankruptcy message flag and liquidity increments 10^10/10^11/10^12. Bankruptcy options affect shared gameplay and need an authority policy; font/color/visibility adapt to local browser presentation. Native allocation remains a portable disposition. Do not put authoritative economy settings into local preferences.

findings.title: Direct buildings lack historical main-menu route
findings.behavior: MainWindow commercial and variable-height commands are commented out; generic picker enumerates GenericStructureContribution, not the 66 commercial/55 variable-height declarations. Retain development-driven use and content accounting. Direct placement UI needs an explicit planned adaptation; do not transfer historical reachable builder status or interpret absent menu as excluded content. Variable-height direct builder/remover stubs remain open.

findings.title: Road extension source defect changed
findings.behavior: ExAV RoadAccessory ControllerForm declares PreviewDrawer drawer in its using statement: historical ACTION-006 undeclared-drawer claim does not apply. No RoadAccessory or DummyCar instance contribution types appear in bundled declarations. Registered menu/factory shells do not establish working bus simulation; selection/null behavior and obsolete DummyCarController still require per-source review.

findings.title: Generic category navigation is Japanese
findings.behavior: CategoryTreeWnd searches the Japanese menu label, so historical ACTION-005 exact English-label defect is no longer the right finding. Exact-label and index navigation remain brittle. Category changes invoke OnNodeSelected only when subscribed. Preserve stable category/design/color/direction/height identity and transaction cost; translate presentation without changing lookup identities.

findings.title: Save dialog and source loader diverge
findings.behavior: ExAV save dialog warns for .ftgd while using updated file filters. BZ detection remains but the BZip2InputStream wrapping line is removed. UI/file extension recognition is not proof of historical import support; assign serializer/default/continuation and compression diagnosis to P0-05.

findings.title: Temporary external music stays excluded
findings.behavior: BGMManager and BGMContributionFactoryImpl permit user-file selection and fileName state. Preserve source evidence, but owner excludes A4/external user-file equivalents; bundled BGM, silence, sound effects and departure bells remain in scope. Neither temporary contributions nor saved fileName authorizes redistributing music or enabling the optional pack.

findings.title: Development tuning is registered in ExAV
findings.behavior: System manifest {develop-config} registers DevelopConfigurePlugin, which merges a menu and opens DevelopConfigure. Historical ACTION-007 source-only disposition is superseded. Apply parses building-price, replacement, diffusion, station-range and land-value parameters; Save writes Core.options.devParams, Load repopulates controls, Cancel closes. Source stores preferences separately from world state and does not automatically reload them on restart. Define server-authoritative parameter edits and continuation/validation policy; local browser settings cannot change shared development rules. Apply assigns fields sequentially inside try/finally and disposes even on parse failure; browser validation/commit must prevent partial authoritative updates.

findings.title: Group delegation is registered, despite defect warning
findings.behavior: World registers DelegationTrainControllerImpl alongside SimpleTrainControllerImpl for non-temporary worlds; TrainPlacementController binds the world controller collection. This supersedes historical ACTION-001 source-only/unregistered status. The NO THIS DOES NOT WORK comment remains a defect warning, not proof of unreachability. Resolve null controller, root fallback, reparenting, cycles, assignment and continuation during P5/P10; do not assume the warning authorizes removing inheritance.
